reply_text:
I've answered Tobias in a thread reply on his message in #inc-tansley-carrier-api: the depot was Southgate.

Everything comes from this incident channel, which Tobias is a member of. On 2025-09-03 Priyanka reported that label printing had stalled at Tansley Parcel depots, with Southgate dispatch's totes stacked beside door 4. Her note closing the incident said Southgate had cleared the backlog.

I couldn't find a street address for the Southgate site in the channel or in the shared files, which had nothing for Tansley. So I told Tobias that if the customer needs the full address, Priyanka is probably the best person to ask.
